mapper.select: select count(*) from users where email = #{email}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users(name, password, phone, email, role) VALUES ( #{name}, #{password}, #{phone, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{email, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{role} )
mapper.select: select * from users where email = #{email} and password = #{password}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM users WHERE email = #{email} AND password = #{password}
